content.text: The migrated file still depends on dpct helpers and a `this_work_item` shim, so I'm rewriting it as plain SYCL 2020: a profiling-enabled queue, `malloc_shared`, a 1-D `nd_range`, and event timing without dpct.

limitations: A successful compile says nothing about numerical correctness; run verify.

input.summary: Ported saxpy.cu to SYCL 2020 in migrated/saxpy.dp.cpp. All dpct:: helpers, DPCT_* macros and #include <dpct/...> are removed. The port uses a profiling-enabled sycl::queue, sycl::malloc_shared/sycl::free, a 1-D nd_range<1> (local 256, global rounded up to a multiple of 256) with a bounds check, q.wait_and_throw(), and event profiling for kernel_ms. The file compiles with icpx -fsycl (add_dpct_include=false, 0 warnings, 0 errors) to build/candidate. Caveats: I have not executed the binary, so the atol 1e-6 match against the CUDA reference output is unverified; the compile tool does not run it. The queue uses sycl::gpu_selector_v, which will throw at runtime if no GPU device is present, so default_selector_v may be preferable on CPU-only hosts.
